gen-dafont-college-gf-noto-sans-kaithi: Noto Sans Kaithi reads sturdy, its lowercase filling the line like capitals. What stands out most is College, whose strokes look pulled like solder through a nozzle, every curve matching the straight stems.
gen-dafont-college-gf-noto-sans-kannada: Noto Sans Kannada reads friendly and current, with a gentle bump from small letters up to capitals and s curves opening wide. College, cut to one width, gives that softness a firm frame.
gen-dafont-college-gf-noto-sans-kayah-li: Noto Sans Kayah Li reads clean, its brush ends lifting away before each curve closes. College looks like sign-shop vinyl cut to a single line width, so the two feel like different tools.
gen-dafont-college-gf-noto-sans-kharosht: Noto Sans Kharoshthi leaves its curves open and lays a thick, dark stripe of lowercase through every line. Noto Sans Kharoshthi feels friendlier beside College, whose pen pressure never wavers from first letter to last.
gen-dafont-college-gf-noto-sans-khmer: Round, unswelling bowls up top: College draws each outline without a single bulge or pinch. Noto Sans Khmer stays easy going down a page, its generous openings and proud, almost capital-sized lowercase keeping paragraphs legible.
gen-dafont-college-gf-noto-sans-khojki: Wide exits, bright eyes: Noto Sans Khojki lets light slip through, giving every e a large, clear eye. But College is the standout, its horizontals never thinner than its verticals.
gen-dafont-college-gf-noto-sans-khudawad: Approachable and clean, Noto Sans Khudawadi keeps capitals close to lowercase height and leaves its rounds unsealed. College, with no heavy downstrokes, gives it a blunt, confident lead to follow.
gen-dafont-college-gf-noto-sans-kr: College arrives hairline-free and shadow-free, every stroke solid. Noto Sans KR then settles into text with generous curve gaps and stubby ascenders beside a big x-height, so lines stay open and legible.
gen-dafont-college-gf-noto-sans-lao: Noto Sans Lao reads tall and forthcoming, its x-height pushed well past usual. Over a full page, those open mouths keep text breathing, while College, with strokes bent like pipe, holds the top.
gen-dafont-college-gf-noto-sans-lao-loop: College holds its line thickness constant from curve to stem, a firm display voice. Noto Sans Lao Looped makes words read as solid blocks, with bowls left unfinished on one side.
